description:
Duration: 2+ Months
Location: RTP (Research Triangle Park), NC 
 
 Job Details: 
 
 Develop scope, plan, initiate and manage delivery of the Qlikview dashboard project. Undertake effective Stakeholder Management. Execute the production of the required deliverables on behalf of the Sponsor. Report progress through agreed reporting mechanisms. Strong interpersonal, design and development qlikview acumen demonstrated through experience with negotiating, design and implementation. Laise with related Program and Project Managers globally to ensure seamless delivery. 
 This resource will be responsible for the design, construction, and deployment of business analytics and reporting systems in Qlikview. 
 Roles and responsibilities: 
• Design, construct, deploy, and test standard reports, dashboards, and data visualizations from MS Excel database using Qlikview 
• Experience with Microsoft Office (specifically Excel) 
• Knowledge of databases and spreadsheets, BI software (Qlikview is a requirement) 
• Qlikview Designer or Developer Certification 
• Identify best practices to communicate metrics through dashboard; recommend enhancements. 
• Strong problem-solving, analytic, conceptual and critical thinking skills. 
• Work across various geographies and time zones (E.g. China, Africa, Europe, UK, US)
